summary.result: Results suggest that DGCI had high correlation with chlorophyll a contents and it has high potential to be utilized as an easy indicator to monitor plants’ responses to CO₂ treatment.
summary.background: To ensure the feasibility of this technology, it is important to monitor the leakage of carbon dioxide and to assess the potential impacts.
summary.method: Currently, chlorophyll a content is a conventional index indicating the changes in plants, however, this method is labor intensive and it only utilizes a small portion of leaves.
